podcast.body: Although seemingly sunny, this "Rumours" single was written by keyboardist Christine McVie as a "genial diss record" aimed at her ex-husband and bandmate, bassist John McVie. "Even the seemingly sunny Rumors single Don't Stop, written by keyboardist Christine McVe was a genial diss record against her ex-husband, bassist John McVe."

podcast.body: Written solely by Christine McVie after her separation from John McVie, this song expressed hope for her post-married life, despite being a breakup song. Often mistaken for a Lindsey Buckingham song because he sang the first verse, McVie sang the second verse and harmonized with Buckingham on the third. It peaked at number three on the Hot 100 by September 1977. "Don't Stop was written by Christine McVeah alone. She sang the second verse and harmonized with Buckingham on the third."
